groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: something done with the hands.

chars.story: A hand sorting through the heap to pick one out.
chars.note: Also 'raise, poke, stir up' and 'challenge': 挑战, 挑起.

chars.story: A hand closing on something: catch.
A hand feeling through a place: search through.
A hand tracing the outline of a sprout: depict.
A hand pushing back with huge force: refuse.
A hand braced against a push: press against.
chars.note: Also 'arrive' and 'offset': 抵达, 抵押 'mortgage'.

chars.story: You see a bad omen and walk away fast: flee.
The way you walked: a route.
Walking right up and pressing in until the space is full: force.
The marks left where someone walked: a trace.
chars.note: 跡 had 足 foot on the left; 迹 has 辶.

chars.story: Water to clean with: wash.
Steps taken in water: wade.
Something dropped in water goes down: sink.
The place on a river where the boat crosses.
Water gone foul: dirty.
A person judging by long experience: estimate.
The other half of a person: a companion.
People who share a fire: partners.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A box on the left: voice and speech.

chars.story: A mouth-sign at a sentence end: 'it's obvious, isn't it?'
A mouth-sign beside 'me': oh, I see.
A mouth taking in liquid: drink.
A woman, good and graceful: a young lady.
An older woman with wavy white hair: grandmother.
What a nursing woman gives: milk.
The one with the big mouth who walks ahead: elder brother.
The altar where forefathers are honored.
A piece of metal pressed to work something: a keyboard key.
Metal links joined together: a chain.
Thread spun day after day: work accomplished.
A knot in a cord: a button.
chars.note: 紐: 糸 became 纟. Also in 纽约 New York.

chars.parts: - a sky line over a cloud and four drops
chars.story: Drops falling from a cloud: rain.
chars.note: On top of a character it means weather.

chars.story: Thunder after rain makes the earth shake: quake.
A foot springing up: jump.
Footsteps measure out the big gap: distance.
Earth raised toward the clouds: an altar, a platform.
chars.note: 壇: the right side shrank to 云.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 井 frame + 土 earth
chars.story: Earth packed under a roof until nothing gets through: block.
Fire's by-product: smoke.
Fire under the roof: disaster.
chars.note: 災 had flood and fire; 灾 keeps the fire.

chars.story: A bird in the yard you reach for: chicken.
chars.note: 雞 had 奚 on the left; 鸡 uses 又.

chars.parts: - a bird with its eye stroke gone
chars.story: A black bird whose eye cannot be seen against its feathers: jet black.
chars.note: Also 'black'. In 乌克兰 Ukraine it spells a name. In 乌鸦 it is 'crow'.

chars.story: What a creature leaves behind: an egg.
A square cut into plots: a field.

chars.parts: - a stalk over 夂 slow foot
chars.story: Grain that stands tall and bends: wheat.
chars.note: 麥 had 來 above 夂. In 麦克 'mic' it spells a name.

chars.story: Stalks hung to dry under a shed: hemp.
A tree set straight in the ground: plant it.
Bamboo slips tied with a cord: a booklet.
Bamboo slips with names written: a registry.
A bamboo tally split in two, the halves fitting: a symbol.
A roof-like net over those who handle affairs: a bureau.

chars.parts: 先 + 先 over 贝 shell
chars.story: Two step forward with shell-money to back the speaker: praise.
chars.note: 贊 had 兟 and 貝.

chars.parts: 酋 wine jar + 寸 hand
chars.story: A hand lifting the wine jar to a superior: honor.

chars.parts: - two hands together over a bar
chars.story: Both hands pressed together, the head bent low: bow.
chars.note: 拜年 is a New Year's visit.

chars.story: A kindness from the heart that is the cause of your good: a favor.
One who steps along behind a master: disciple.
Giving someone strength: encourage.
chars.note: 勵: 厲 shrank to 厉.

chars.parts: 壴 drum + 支 hand with stick
chars.story: A drum on a stand and a hand with a stick: drum.
A place you arrive at and lie down: a house.
Wood under a shed: a bed.
A tile on a roof.
A dish shaped like a boat: a plate.
Three flowing lines: a river.

chars.parts: 山 mountain + 厂 cliff + 干
chars.story: A cliff at the water's edge: the shore.
Water that has frozen: ice.
A weed that comes up everywhere.
chars.note: Mostly in foreign names and loan words.

chars.story: A woman who acts as mother: nanny.
chars.note: Also in foreign names, as in 欧姆 'ohm'.

chars.story: A prosperous town: a state.
chars.note: 邦 is the town sign 阝 on the right; 阝 on the left is a mound.

chars.story: Water flowing under a great man: peace.
The flat face of the hand: the palm.
A single tall hair: fine hair.
Old flesh with hair: a beard.
chars.note: Also 'recklessly', a surname, and 'foreign' in old texts.

chars.parts: 冖 cover + 元 head + 寸 hand
chars.story: A hand setting a cover on the head: a crown.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 圭 jade tablet
chars.story: A person bearing a jade tablet: fine.
A stalk of grain with the ear coming out: refined.
A dish filled to overflowing: flourishing.
An honored visitor under your roof: guest.
chars.note: 賓 had 貝 shell; 宾 has the soldier shape.

chars.story: A strong-armed bird: powerful, and male.

chars.parts: 弓 bow + 弓 bow (each with feathers)
chars.story: Two soft, bent bows: weak.
Bones left over after ruin: cruel, remaining.
chars.note: Also 'remnant, left over'. 殘 had two 戈; 残 has 戋.

chars.story: An empty shed, put out of use: abolish, waste.
chars.note: 廢 had 發; 废 uses 发.

chars.story: A beast that thinks it is king: mad.
A ghost tangled in hemp: devil.

chars.parts: 犭 animal + 讠 words + 犬 dog
chars.story: Two dogs guarding a man's words: prison.
A big hand grabbing: seize.
chars.note: 奪 had a bird 隹; 夺 drops it.

chars.story: A thorn and a knife: prick.
An insect feeling forward with its horns: touch.
chars.note: 觸 had 蜀; 触 has 虫.

chars.story: A mound in the way: hinder.

chars.parts: 取 take + 乑 three people
chars.story: Three people drawn together: assemble.
Money pasted on, a note stuck up: stick on.

chars.parts: - a hand holding two stalks of grain
chars.story: One hand grasping two stalks at once: double up.
A horse tied at its master's post: stationed.
Carts counted in pairs: one vehicle.
chars.note: Counts cars, bikes, wagons: 一辆车. 輛: 車 became 车.

chars.story: Walking flat out over every part: everywhere.
Kneeling to roll up a scroll: roll up.
chars.note: Also counts rolls and 'volumes' of a book.

chars.story: A heart so taken up it is lost to all else: busy.
Something tucked behind a mound: hidden.
chars.note: 隱 had a more elaborate right side.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 日 sun + 大
chars.story: The sun sinks into the grass: dusk, and nothing more can be done.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'no one'. Modern 莫 is formal 'do not, none'.

chars.story: A bar across the top of the tree marks its tip: the final part.
Two men take turns in the sun: one substitutes for the other.
A square of cloth streaming from a pole: flag.
A pellet in a furnace: red cinnabar.
chars.note: Mostly in 丹麦 and 牡丹.

sentences.en: He creates melodies on his keyboard.
I don't agree with you smoking.
I was busy studying for the term exam.

sentences.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
sentences.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.

sentences.zh: 我进屋的时候，他们都鼓掌了。
sentences.en: As I entered the room, they applauded.

sentences.zh: 狂风暴雨造成她无法准时抵达。
sentences.en: The storm prevented her from arriving on time.
